notes.title: Multiplayer Update and Escape Room Player Profiles
notes.content:
Dive into the all-new multiplayer room and experience Lethe like never before—now with your friends by your side. Explore together, solve puzzles cooperatively, and see how your unique playstyles complement each other in real-time.

With the introduction of player profiles, your gameplay becomes more personalized than ever. Whether you're a methodical strategist or a bold risk-taker, the game adapts to your behavior, creating challenges tailored to your approach.

Plus, unlock a whole new layer of motivation with Steam Achievements! Track your progress, celebrate your victories, and aim for 100% completion as you uncover the secrets of Lethe.

This update isn’t just an expansion—it’s a transformation. Lethe evolves into a more immersive, dynamic, and collaborative experience.
Ready to escape... together?
